## Outcome

What changes for a person using Web?

## Boundary review

- [ ] Renderer remains presentation-only; privileged work stays in typed Rust commands.
- [ ] No telemetry, cloud-model fallback, scraping, credential import, or engagement mechanic was added.
- [ ] Untrusted input and retention/deletion behavior were considered.
- [ ] `REMAINING-WORK.md` reflects any changed implementation or acceptance evidence.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm verify`
- [ ] Native/package evidence is included when this change touches a native workflow.
- [ ] Platform claims are limited to the host evidence actually gathered.
